assets.desc: EXACTLY the same container as in the attached image (same shape, size, paint, corners, stencil icon, camera angle and lighting), but now OPENED and already looted: lid removed and leaning against the side, crate empty inside. Nothing inside. Transparent background, no ground, no text. LOOT CONTAINER KIT — every item shares the SAME design language: faded, worn, muted ochre-orange paint (Soviet army/fire-equipment orange, dusty and chipped, not saturated), dark steel corner plates and latches, a small white stencilled number, and ONE clear stencilled icon on the front that hints at the contents. Volume like Project Zomboid sprites: light from the top-left, shaded right side, dark contact shadow at the base.
